_note: Design source for the 4 themed dimensions (Frostfell, Verdant Ruins, Ashlands, Neon-Cyber). Produced by the design-dimensions workflow (§17). Feeds tools/artkit codegen for shared/dimensions + enemies, and the art pipeline subjects. Palettes may be '#rrggbb' or '0xrrggbb' — codegen normalizes both. Wild West (dimension 1) lives directly in shared/dimensions.ts.

dimensions.name: Frostfell
dimensions.tagline: The cathedral froze mid-prayer, and the prayer answered.

hazard.name: Black-ice slicks
hazard.description: Glassy frozen meltwater sheets the nave in dark mirror-slicks. Step on one and you keep sliding — momentum carries you past where you stopped steering, drifting into contact range or off the lip of a frozen pit. A pale freezing fog clings low over each slick so the edges read before you commit (§17).

enemies.name: Frostbitten Revenant
enemies.artPrompt: Frostbitten Revenant — a fast ice-corpse rusher enemy, limbless construction, FULL build, generated empty-handed. A gaunt charcoal-and-steel cathedral-corpse body, one rounded pill torso sheathed in a crust of pale blue hoarfrost and a cracked frozen monk's-cowl hood shadowing the face to a dark void with ONE small glowing cyan dot-eye, frost-rimed shoulders. EXACTLY TWO detached frost-knuckled blob hands (rounded mitts, NO fingers), one floating clear of each side, TWO detached frozen blob feet below in ice-caked stumps — every detached part sits fully OUTSIDE the body silhouette with a clear flat-green gap. A lean, lurching, hungry side-on silhouette facing RIGHT. Cold blue-white over grim charcoal; ~4-6 colours, bold uniform black outline, flat cel shading; NO glow/VFX baked in (the cyan reads lit purely by colour).

enemies.name: Shriek-Wraith
enemies.artPrompt: Shriek-Wraith — a single shrieking wraith-swarm unit. A PURE BLOB build: a tiny tattered dark-teal spectral body-blob (fist-sized) trailing a ragged frozen funeral-shroud hem, ONE small glowing pale-white pinprick eye and a thin gaping shadow where a mouth would be, faint frost-flecks crusting the hem — NO detached hands and NO detached feet. Weak, fast and ghostly, designed to read as ONE clean bold shape in a screaming cloud of many, side-on facing RIGHT. Desaturated cold palette, ~4 colours, bold uniform black outline, flat cel shading; NO glow/VFX baked in.

boss.name: THE HOLLOW KING, Lich of the Frozen Choir
boss.phases: Phase 1 — THE FROZEN KING (100-66% HP): a slow, tanky armoured advance. Closes in plate and hews with the Tombstone Greatsword (wieldsWeapon) in heavy telegraphed arcs, punctuating with single aimed frostbolts (the ranged block) to punish kiting. Reads as a brawler that wants you in sword range. Phase 2 — THE SHATTERED LICH (66-33%): the ice-armour cracks and falls away; the King speeds up (~1.5x) and trades single bolts for ICE-SHARD VOLLEYS — fanned frostbolt cones that seed black-ice slicks where they land, weaponising the dimension hazard. Periodically plants a ring of hoarfrost spires that vent freezing fog, forcing repositioning. Phase 3 — THE FROZEN CHOIR (33-0%): the lich kneels and CONDUCTS — summoning waves of shriek-wraiths and frostbitten-revenant adds while raising a slow rotating barrier of orbiting ice-shards around itself, only opening firing lanes briefly. The greatsword swings return as a desperate point-blank sweep when cornered. A summon-and-zone finale: clear the choir, slip the shard-ring, and land the kill.
boss.artPrompt: THE HOLLOW KING, Lich of the Frozen Choir — the Frostfell main boss, an ORIGINAL frozen-lich silhouette, limbless construction, FULL build, generated EMPTY-HANDED (its greatsword is a separate asset). A gigantic, looming ice-king: one towering charcoal-and-steel body sheathed in fractured glacier-plate, a high cracked frost-crown fused to a frozen great-helm shadowing the face to a deep dark void with TWO small cold-cyan dot-eyes, a heavy frozen royal mantle crusted to the shoulders and ending in a clean ragged frost-rimed hem (NO billowing cloth), shards of blue ice jutting from the back. EXACTLY TWO huge detached frost-gauntlet blobs (rounded, NO fingers, empty), TWO massive detached ice-locked foot-blobs, all with clear flat-green gaps. Built from BOLD SIMPLE SHAPES at the SAME clean flat-cel detail level as a normal character — menace from SCALE and a strong silhouette, NOT busy intricacy. Side-on facing RIGHT, planted and regal. Glacier-blue, steel-grey and bone over deep charcoal, ~5-6 colours, uniform black outline, flat cel shading; NO glow/VFX baked in (the cyan eyes read lit purely by colour contrast).

boss.name: GREENGRASP, the Moss-Stone Golem
boss.phases: Three-phase temple guardian. PHASE 1 (100-66% HP) STONE WARDEN: slow, tanky, plods toward the squad and cleaves with the granite Tombstone Greatsword (wieldsWeapon) on a heavy melee swing. PHASE 2 (66-33% HP) OVERGROWTH: cracks split open and it gains a ranged attack — lobs a 3-spore SPREAD volley of toxic seed-pods (the ranged.spread block) that seed lingering toxin-spore pools (the dimension hazard) on impact, forcing repositioning while it keeps cleaving. PHASE 3 (below 33% HP) FERAL BLOOM: enraged — moves faster, melee cooldown tightens, and on each cleave it belches a venom cloud and births a few Venom-Spore swarm units (add-spawn) to swarm the squad as it makes its last stand.
boss.artPrompt: GREENGRASP, the Moss-Stone Golem — the Verdant Ruins main boss, an ORIGINAL limbless construction, FULL build, generated EMPTY-HANDED (its greatsword is a separate asset). A colossal hulking guardian built from mossed temple-masonry: a blocky cracked-granite torso bound in thick olive vines and lime lichen, a heavy carved-idol head with a horned brow over a dark void face and two glowing plasma-lime DOT eyes, jagged stone shoulders sprouting ferns, deep fissures glowing faint lime in the cracks (drawn as flat bright shapes, NOT blooming light). TWO massive detached boulder fist-blobs (rounded, no fingers), TWO huge detached slab foot-blobs, clear flat-#00ff00 gaps. Gigantic and looming — menace from SCALE and a strong silhouette, built from BOLD SIMPLE SHAPES at the SAME clean flat-cel and detail level as a normal character (NOT busier, NOT more intricate — only bigger). Side-on facing RIGHT, upright and planted, neutral stance. Bold uniform black outline, flat cel shading, ~4-6 colours. On a flat opaque #00ff00 field, no ground, no VFX, no glow-bloom.

dimensions.name: Ashlands

hazard.name: Lava cracks & fire vents
hazard.description: Glowing fissures split the basalt floor and pressure-vents flare on a cycle — the §17 pit-rim language re-skinned as molten cracks (hot amber lip = the burn telegraph). Standing on a lit crack or a venting tile chips you and snap-repositions, same as a Wild-West mineshaft fall; the cool cyan spawn ring stays the one safe pad.

boss.name: MOLTEN BRUTE, the Ashlands' Heart
boss.phases: Three escalating phases gated on HP (matching the §16 OLD RUST multi-phase model). PHASE 1 (100-66% HP) — CRUST: a slow, tanky bruiser that lumbers toward the squad and lobs single arcing magma-bolts on the ~1.6s ranged cooldown (the basic kite-and-spit pressure). PHASE 2 (66-33% HP) — FRACTURE: the crust splits; it speeds up slightly, its magma-bolt cooldown tightens and each volley becomes a small ember-mote scatter (a fanned spread instead of a single bolt — reuses the scatter/cone framework like Gatlin), so it zones the floor while still closing. PHASE 3 (<33% HP) — MELTDOWN: enraged, it drops the ranged spit and commits to BRUTE melee — fast lunging slab-slams with the Reaper's Lid (x-sword-coffin) and heavy contact damage, a desperate close-range finisher. A clear tell + a brief stagger marks each phase transition.

A gigantic, looming, barrel-chested body of cracked black basalt and cooled lava, the deep fissures across its torso and shoulders showing as bold solid flat ember-orange and dull-red crack-shapes (NEVER glowing/blooming), a massive craggy head fused to hunched obsidian shoulders, a dark void face with TWO heavy ember dot-eyes and a cracked brow ridge. Limbless-adjacent: TWO huge detached molten fist-blobs (rounded, NO fingers) and TWO heavy detached basalt foot-blobs, each with clear flat-green gaps. Built from BOLD SIMPLE SHAPES at the SAME clean flat-cel ~4-6 colour detail level as a normal character — menace comes from SCALE and a strong silhouette, NOT from busy detail. Side-on facing RIGHT, planted upright. On a flat opaque #00ff00 field, NO VFX, NO baked glow, original/trademark-distinct.

boss.name: WARDEN-7, the Security Mech
boss.phases: Phase 1 (100-66% HP) LOCKDOWN PATROL: slow advance, sweeps its Gatling in measured aimed bursts at the nearest drifter (the wieldsWeapon held-gun) while contact-checking anyone who crowds it. Phase 2 (66-33% HP) GRID OVERRIDE: at the threshold it energizes the arena's laser-grid hazard — more rows/columns go hot, on faster cycles — and raises its fire cadence (shorter cooldown, longer bursts), boxing the squad into the safe traces. Phase 3 (<33% HP) MELTDOWN ENFORCER: armor breached, it speeds up and goes aggressive — alternating a charging contact-slam (the renderScale bulk as a body weapon) with desperate full-auto spray, the grid strobing at its tightest cycle. On death it always DROPS its Gatling (dropWeapon 1).
